messages:
maya: quick sync on regen diffs UX — current state: every diff row has a primary 'Approve' which gets noisy on big runs. suggestion: collapse row primaries, add a top toolbar CTA 'Approve selected' + light per-row checkbox.
owen: +1. want the CTA disabled until selection > 0 and show '3 selected' so state is explicit.
lisa: accessibility: make toolbar next in DOM after the list so tab order is predictable. add an aria-live polite region that announces changes like '3 of 12 selected'. ensure checkboxes are keyboard reachable with 44px target.
devon: copy: change modal text from vague "Are you sure?" to: title "Approve 3 outputs" body "This will mark 3 outputs as accepted for this eval run. You can undo from the toast or revert individual outputs in run history." primary: "Approve 3 outputs" secondary: "Cancel".
nana: microcopy tweak for badges: replace 'Pass/Fail' with 'Meets threshold / Needs review' — softer and action-oriented.
maya: behavior question: small bulk confirms (<5) could be inline confirm vs full modal for larger batches. feels faster.
own: okay but inline confirm should still be accessible (role=dialog) and trap focus for keyboard.
lisa: color check: current primary #1976d2 doesn't meet 4.5:1 on 14px text. propose #0e4fb0 for CTA and add a visible, non-color-dependent focus ring (1.5px solid + outline-offset).
devon: engineering note: debounce the approve action (500ms) and disable CTA while request inflight. show spinner in CTA to give feedback.
nana: variant pill request: show a small model-variant pill per row (abbr name, hover/focus reveals full model). keep pill subtle (12px height) and keyboard focusable with aria-describedby tooltip.
maya: compact view idea: toggle that hides unchanged context and shows inline expand for hunks. default to compact for runs > 10 diffs.
own: ensure chevrons have aria-expanded and target size >= 44px. mobile tested.
lisa: add keyboard shortcut Shift+A to approve selected (announce via SR: 'Approve shortcut activated'), open confirm. document in keyboard shortcuts modal.
devon: undo UX: toast '3 outputs approved — Undo' role=alert, undo button tabbable, TTL 15s. bulk undo maps to server-side action id so we can revert set atomically.
nana: I'll update design tokens for color + spacing (increase gap between selected-count and actions).
design-bot: Reminder: design review 2024-11-20 11:00am PT. Agenda: toolbar placement, inline vs modal confirm rules, compact view defaults, accessibility checklist, undo mapping.
maya: great — I'll post annotated mocks and a short keyboard-flow spec after the review. :thumbsup:
